$comment: Type gate for the UI Command Center. INDEPENDENT of the root tsconfig.json.
The root gate is `include: [platform/**/*.ts, .pi/extensions/*.ts]` and the root
test globs are `platform/**` only, so this workspace is invisible to the kernel's
gates by construction rather than by remembering to exclude it. That is why the
frontend carries its OWN tsconfig instead of being added to the root one.
Two flags are ON here that the root gate relaxes, deliberately:
noUncheckedIndexedAccess  the root relaxes this because it tripled the error
count (123 vs 78) across platform/**. That is a
migration cost on an existing codebase, not an
argument against the flag. New code can hold the
exactOptionalPropertyTypes  so `{ agentId?: string }` cannot be handed
'present and null' is load-bearing in the portal
config, where the backend distinguishes them.
types:[] -- `describe`/`it`/`expect` are IMPORTED from vitest in every test file
rather than injected as globals. Explicit imports are checkable by the compiler;
ambient test globals are a typo that passes silently until the suite runs.
